outputs.prompt: Create one production-ready square 1024x1024 base-color texture for a used blue-grey painted steel stair, using the attached real checker-plate stair photograph only as a material reference. IMPORTANT: Output a completely flat, uniformly lit orthographic albedo swatch covering the entire image; NO actual checker diamonds or raised geometry, no baked shadows, no highlights, no gradients, no stair outline, no border, no text. Geometry and its lighting will be supplied by Blender. Muted dark blue-grey enamel like aged Korean villa utility stairs, average sRGB about #4E6369. Fine irregular small paint scuffs and faint gray dust, occasional tiny exposed dull steel scratches, gentle low contrast with maximum 10 percent tonal variation. No rust splatter, no giant cracks, no graphic pattern, no artistic grunge. Fine physically plausible brush/rolled enamel surface, subtle real wear. All edges must tile seamlessly.

Create a sober photorealistic three-view modeling reference sheet of ONE modest rooftop domestic stainless steel water storage tank, using the supplied real Korean manufacturer's photographs for fabrication details and physical proportions. The blue FRP reference establishes only the compact 2,000 litre vertical cylinder proportions: 1.30m diameter, 1.60m body height. Use stainless steel sheet finish and flanged fittings from the other reference, NOT blue plastic, NOT a rectangular panel tank. Show front elevation, three-quarter view, and rear view of the SAME physically coherent vertical stainless cylinder on a shallow low concrete plinth. A slightly conical shallow lid with a small closed circular access hatch, two subtle horizontal rolled stiffening beads, bottom outlet, overflow near top with a downturned elbow, restrained narrow weld seam. Everyday Korean low-rise rooftop utility equipment maintained but used; dull brushed steel, no mirror chrome, slight rain marks and very little rust. Front has a small rectangular blank metal nameplate. There must be NO ladder, no fantasy hoses or control screens, no dramatic cinematic lighting, no text or watermark copied from the references. Plain pale grey background. Keep dimensions and fittings consistent across views.
